## Скачать / Download

| Система / OS | Файл / File |
|---|---|
| Windows 10/11 (x64) | `YTDownloader-windows.exe` |
| Linux (x86_64) | `YTDownloader-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` |
| macOS (Apple Silicon M1+) | `YTDownloader-macos-arm64.zip` |

Как запустить на каждой системе, описано в [README (RU)](https://github.com/c200656-create/yt-downloader#скачать). For setup steps on each OS, see the [README (EN)](https://github.com/c200656-create/yt-downloader/blob/main/README.en.md#download).
